answer: Concretely, the economy can chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its delta recurs, its opal survives audit, and a trellis from an unlinked peer confirms it.
